verdict.rationale: Activepieces can be run locally as a dev instance: a one-line install script, Docker Compose, and a single-container option with an embedded database for one machine. Piece development gets in-browser hot reload within about 7 seconds, and draft edits stay separate from the published flow until you click publish. The built-in MCP server also claims to be able to test automations. However, nothing documents running or testing flows from CI, and a community user reported that the docker-compose setup only pulls published images, with dev setup instructions missing. Missing for 10: a documented CI or headless flow-testing workflow, a CLI or API for triggering test runs, promoting flows between dev and prod instances, and independent hands-on corroboration of a smooth local dev loop.
